formula.proportional_results: When AFDocs supplies a page-level passed/total ratio, use that exact 0..1 proportion instead of a fixed status coefficient.
formula.skip: AFDocs checks skipped because dependencies did not pass are preserved as skip and excluded from the denominator.
formula.not_applicable: excluded from the denominator only with a recorded safety reason
formula.perfect_score_gate: All required criteria pass and both selected journeys have current activation evidence.
